description: This Java source file defines the AddVoicemailActivity class, which is an Android activity used to create and store voicemails, including recording audio, setting metadata, and inserting data into a voicemail content provider.

classes.name: AddVoicemailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that allows users to record voicemail, input metadata, and insert the voicemail data into a content provider.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and assigns click listeners.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default values for time and provider package in the UI.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts an intent to record audio using the device's microphone.

methods.name: handleRecordingResult
methods.description: Processes the result of the recording activity, storing the URI and updating UI.

methods.name: buildVoicemailObjectFromUiElements
methods.description: Constructs a Voicemail object from user input in the UI.

methods.name: storeVoicemail
methods.description: Begins the process to insert the voicemail data into the provider.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity results, particularly the recording result.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs for the activity, typically used for error messages.
